title: Retuned word-aligned length-64 product with shared parity and correction storage

claims.statement: For the explicit product of 31 systematic [64,32] components and one [16,8] tail, and the counted marked-syndrome decoder of proof.md, the average block error for uniform 1000-bit data on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 124987431037410233/125000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=283 primitives on every received word and W<=2^(407233/50000).

experiments.purpose: Verify complete exact syndrome leader and reserved-address histograms in each invariant sector, exact product bound, and the fixed schedule in sector zero.
